title: A chain started again after a restart takes over the bench run it already queued instead of waiting and starting the same work again
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A plan step whose start is refused because a run is active looks for its own run (started by cli:step-chain, same research revision, same kit), takes it over, never waits and never queues a second planner run.
When the active run is not this build's own, the step waits as before and then starts its own run.
A pictures (or copy) step takes over only a run on the same plan, and takes over nothing when its plan file cannot be read.

tests: a plan step started again takes over its own active planner run and queues no second one
another build's active run is still waited for, then this step starts its own
a pictures step adopts only a run on the same plan, and nothing when its plan cannot be read
